verdict.rationale: Finix is a payments-infrastructure platform, so agent-initiated checkout is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents marketplace and platform payments (seller onboarding, payouts, tokenization, checkout pages), but nothing covers agentic-commerce protocols, delegated payment credentials, or agent-initiated checkout tied to split funds flows. The MCP server described is only for asking an AI agent questions about the Finix API documentation, not for transacting.
